ideas.title: Following the Money in Federal Investigations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the flow of money in federal investigations, including the Gateway Tunnel Project funding investigation and the Minnesota Somali fraud investigation.
questions: How much money is involved in these investigations?
Who are the key players and what are their roles?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can gain a better understanding of the scope and complexity of these investigations and identify potential wrongdoing.
